headline: SK hynix reportedly in talks with Intel over US memory plants
summary: Two outlets report that SK hynix and Intel are in talks about manufacturing memory chips in the United States, and both report that nothing is settled. They differ on the denial: one says SK hynix told it directly that no plans are final, the other that both companies refused to confirm the reports.
